content_sections.heading: Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Important Dates
content_sections.text: Candidates planning to apply for the Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Vacancy 2026 should note the following dates as given in the official notification. The notification does not mention any separate written examination date, as selection is merit-based (see the Selection Process section below). No correction window for submitted applications has been specified; the notice states that offline correction of application errors will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Vacancy 2026 - Project-wise Details
content_sections.text: A total of 146 Anganwadi Karyakartri posts are vacant across the nine Bal Vikas Pariyojna (Child Development Project) areas of Muzaffarnagar district. The category-wise (reservation) break-up given in the notification is as follows. The notification states that a full gram sabha/ward-wise break-up of these vacancies, along with the complete reservation and eligibility details, is displayed at the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil and Vikas Khand offices of the district, and is also uploaded on the official website, upanganwadibharti.in. The notice also clarifies that the number of advertised vacant posts may increase or decrease depending on special circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The eligibility conditions for the Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026 are set out below, exactly as stated in the notification. Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. The minimum educational qualification for the post of Anganwadi Karyakartri is Intermediate (12th) pass or an equivalent qualification. Candidates holding a higher qualification, up to postgraduate level, will have their merit prepared on the basis of that higher qualification, with marks/grades converted according to the formula approved by the concerned board or university for grading and CGPA. As per the notification, the age cut-off date is 1 July 2026. The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years as on the cut-off date. Only the date of birth recorded in the High School mark sheet/certificate will be accepted for age calculation. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly. A candidate is eligible only for the vacant post of the ward/gram sabha of which she is a permanent resident. If an eligible candidate is not available in that ward/gram sabha, then a permanent resident of the concerned Nyaya Panchayat is eligible. For posts in the same gram sabha/ward (urban areas), the notification lays down the following order of preference among eligible candidates: Widow BPL (Below Poverty Line) candidate Divorced/deserted BPL candidate BPL candidate Widow APL (Above Poverty Line) candidate Divorced/deserted APL candidate APL candidate For a widow candidate, the death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Adhikari or the concerned Nagar Nikay, along with the family register (parivar panjika), will be accepted as proof. For divorced or deserted candidates, a valid legal order issued by the competent higher court will be accepted. Residence and caste certificates will be accepted only if they are online, digitally signed certificates issued by the Tehsil and are verifiable online. Income certificates will be accepted only if issued by the competent authority under UP Revenue Department Government Order No. 3959/1-9-11-Ra0-9 dated 30 September 2011, and verifiable online. The BPL income limit is as redetermined under Samaj Kalyan Anubhag-2 Government Order No. 22/2015/2123/26-2-2015 dated 14 September 2015 (as amended), separately for rural and urban areas.

content_sections.heading: Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the post of Anganwadi Karyakartri is made through a merit list prepared on the basis of the candidate's educational qualification, using the grading/CGPA conversion formula approved by the relevant board or university. Where more than one eligible candidate exists in the same ward/gram sabha, the category-wise priority order described in the Eligibility section (widow BPL, divorced/deserted BPL, BPL, widow APL, divorced/deserted APL, APL) is applied. The notification does not mention any separate written examination or interview stage.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible female candidates can apply online for the advertised Anganwadi Karyakartri posts only through the official departmental website, upanganwadibharti.in. Applications can be submitted online from 13 August 2026 up to 2 September 2026 (till midnight, 12:00 a.m.). Offline application forms will not be accepted or recognised under any circumstances. Candidates should keep the following in mind before submitting the online application, as per the notification: Applications will be accepted only through the prescribed online form on the official website within the given time period. If any error is found in the application, or if any fact, figure or educational document submitted is found incorrect or forged, the candidature will be rejected, and full responsibility for this will lie with the candidate. No offline request for correction of an application will be considered. Detailed forms, complete eligibility conditions and the ward/gram sabha-wise vacancy list are available on upanganwadibharti.in and on notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhavan, Tehsil and Vikas Khand offices. Further information can be obtained from the concerned Child Development Project Office (block level) or from the District Programme Officer Office (Bal Vikas Seva Evam Pushtahar Vibhag) during office hours.

faq.question: Q1. What is Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Office of the District Programme Officer, Muzaffarnagar, to fill vacant, honorarium-based Anganwadi Karyakartri posts in the urban and rural Bal Vikas Pariyojna areas of Muzaffarnagar district, notified on 12 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 146 vacant posts of Anganwadi Karyakartri are available across nine project areas of Muzaffarnagar district.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Muzaffarnagar Anganwadi Karyakartri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 2 September 2026, till midnight (12:00 a.m.).

faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) pass or equivalent. Candidates with higher qualifications, up to postgraduate level, are also considered, with merit based on their highest qualification.

faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, as on the cut-off date of 1 July 2026.
